personality_one_liner: A high-performance command center for trading, designed for fast scanning and tactical precision.

spacing.rule: Dense and structural. Use tight margins (md: 12) to allow high information density. Rely on tonal separation and borders instead of shadows.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for data-dense screens to prioritize clarity and speed.
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism on dense data screens, charts, or operational dashboards as it introduces visual noise.

screens.name: Mercados (Watchlist)
screens.purpose: A live view of crypto, forex, and stocks with real-time price updates.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty chart, text 'Nenhum ativo na watchlist', CTA 'Adicionar Ativos'.
states.error: Text 'Falha ao carregar mercados', 'Tentar Novamente' button.

screens.layout: Header with title 'Mercados' and search icon. A segmented control (Cripto | Forex | Ações) below the header. A flat list of rows. Each row: Left side has the asset logo (real PNG) and Symbol/Name; right side has the current price and a percentage change pill (Green for positive, Red for negative). Tapping a row pushes the Chart screen. Use strict structural borders between rows.

screens.name: Chart & Negociação (Pushed Screen)
screens.purpose: Candlestick chart with Smart Money overlays and order execution sheet.
screens.layout: Full-screen layout. Top bar: Asset symbol, current price. Main area: Candlestick chart. A horizontal scrollable chip row below the chart to toggle SMC overlays (Order Blocks, FVG, BOS). Bottom: A sticky container with two massive pill buttons: 'Comprar' (Green) and 'Vender' (Red), which opens a bottom sheet to enter order details (Paper trading).

screens.name: Sinais AI
screens.purpose: Feed of AI-generated Smart Money trading signals.

states.empty: No signals available at the moment.

screens.layout: Header with 'Sinais' and a Settings icon to access 'Plugins'. List of signal cards. Each card: Header with Asset Symbol and 'COMPRA' (Green) or 'VENDA' (Red) badge. Body includes AI analysis text ('Entry at X, Stop Loss Y, Target Z').

screens.name: Plugins de Estratégia (Settings Modal)
screens.layout: A stacked list of toggleable plugins (SMC, RSI, EMA Cross, MACD, Bollinger). When a switch is active, a sub-form expands with parameter inputs (e.g., RSI Length, EMA fast/slow). Sticky 'Guardar Configurações' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Backtest
screens.purpose: Configure and run a strategy backtest and view results.

states.empty: Select parameters to run a backtest.

screens.layout: Two-tab or two-section scrollable view. Configuration: Dropdowns for Strategy, Asset, Timeframe. A massive sticky 'Executar Backtest' CTA at the bottom. Once executed, Results section appears showing an Equity Curve chart, and a grid of performance metrics (Win Rate, Profit Factor, Drawdown, Total Trades) using monospace typography (Rajdhani).

screens.name: Portfólio
screens.purpose: Manage paper trading portfolio, balance, and history.

states.empty: No active trades. 'Ir para Mercados' CTA.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying Total Balance ($) and daily P&L. Below it, a segmented control (Posições Abertas | Histórico). List of active trades with current profit/loss and a 'Fechar' (Close) button.

screens.name: Login (Google)
screens.layout: Cinematic dark background with a subtle brandTertiary gradient at the top. Large SmartTrade AI logo/wordmark. A solid white 'Entrar com Google' button anchored at the bottom with a Google icon. No other distractions.

login_bg.alt: abstract dark financial market chart background

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the '7 Dark-First Utility' personality. Use sharp structural borders instead of shadows.
Do NOT use pure black backgrounds. The primary background is #101113. Use surfaceSecondary (#1C1C1E) for cards and lists.
Do NOT use blue or purple anywhere. The primary brand color is Orange/Rust (#EA580C).
Use Rajdhani for headings, metrics, numbers, and display text. Use IBM Plex Sans for body text.
For the Chart screen and Backtest Results, rely on monospace styling for numbers to ensure alignment and readability.
When displaying asset lists, use real PNGs (provided in images, or use image selector) instead of placeholder icons.
Ensure the 'Executar Backtest' and 'Comprar/Vender' buttons are massive and sticky at the bottom, within safe areas.
Text over the login background image MUST have a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surface color at >=70% opacity) for readability.
All UI text must be in Portuguese (pt-PT).
